## Notes

**Quick read:** Fit, sporty young mom with a baby girl (about 12 to 15 months) filming a bright, funny talking-head demo in a rustic kitchen; recruited by outreach Sep 4, one approved video (Sep 16) not yet running in any ad.
**Best next move:** get her approved video into an ad so she sees results, and send the first weekly inspo; her "Clearly a mom with a velcro baby invented this" hook is one of the better openers on the roster.

### Style (from watching her videos)
- On camera: slim mom with hair in a high bun, brown sports bra and camo shorts, energetic and funny. Baby girl roughly 12 to 15 months, blonde, pink top, chewing on things. Setting: a warm wood-ceiling kitchen with cast iron pans hanging over a range; camera is set behind a granite counter, which fills the bottom third of the frame. Checkered sling.
- Format: yapper, 40 seconds, no burned-in text in the frames I saw. Hook: "Clearly a mom with a velcro baby invented this." Demo covers the padded strap, both adjusters, rolling the strap tail into the little bungee, the checkered print, "she's just chilling", and "so much better than one of those bulky carriers".
- What worked: b2544736 approved Sep 16; 0 ads so far, so no data.
- Safety and checklist: seat under her bottom and legs out looks right; baby is high and close. Watch items: at about 28s she turns to show the back and at 35s her supporting hand is not clearly on the baby ("she's just chilling" moment). Filmed in front of the stove (not cooking, which is fine, but a different room would be safer for copycats). The counter blocking the lower frame cuts off the seat in some shots, so film a little higher.
- Strengths: great hook, clear and complete demo (including the strap tuck nobody else shows), natural humour.
- To improve: keep a hand visibly on her through the turn; move the camera so the seat is in frame.
